title: Agent App registry
description: User-level index of known Agent Apps, stored in the framework home (A2APP_HOME, default ~/.a2app). An index, not a source of truth: each app's manifest.json remains authoritative for its identity, and an app is complete without a registry entry (framework section 5.6).

id.description: the app's manifest id (authoritative in the manifest, mirrored here)

path.description: absolute path to the app directory

port.description: the port assigned at creation; the app binds it and operate commands reach it there (section 5.5)

blueprint.description: toolkit id the app was scaffolded from, when any

$comment: No `status` field by design: running/stopped/missing is derived at read time by probing the app and its path, because a stored status rots silently (section 5.6). Host-specific concerns (theme, icon, session, backup policy, tunnels) stay with the host.
